name: Price
summary: Passive target-formatted commerce price with current, compare-at, and unit-price parts.

anatomy.name: root
anatomy.description: Passive inline price wrapper without widget, group, or live-region semantics.

anatomy.name: compare
anatomy.description: Native s element for a no-longer-current compare-at price.

anatomy.name: label
anatomy.description: Localized visually hidden text that identifies a current, compare-at, or unit-price part.

variants.name: default
variants.description: Current price with optional unit-price content.

variants.name: on-sale
variants.description: Current sale price plus a target-validated compare-at price.

states.name: default
states.description: Passive readable content. Dynamic updates and announcements belong to the owning target region.

behavior.name: targetFormatting
behavior.description: Targets supply complete locale-, currency-, rounding-, range-, and measurement-aware strings; Price performs no parsing or arithmetic.

behavior.name: saleComposition
behavior.description: On-sale composition requires current and compare-at values plus localized part labels; the target validates the commercial relationship.

behavior.name: bidirectionalIsolation
behavior.description: Each formatted value uses native bdi isolation while localized labels follow the surrounding language direction.

behavior.name: targetOwnedUpdates
behavior.description: Price is not a live region. A product, cart, or checkout adapter owns price-change status timing, deduplication, and focus context.

behavior.name: openTypeFeatures
behavior.description: Four independent accepted OpenType switches fail progressively when the active font does not support a requested feature. Slashed zero is deliberately disabled by the system and is not a public option.

properties.name: currentPrice
properties.description: Complete target-formatted current payable price, range, or truthful price text.

properties.name: currentPriceLabel
properties.unsetBehavior: Omit the current label when adjacent context already makes a non-sale price unambiguous; provide it for on-sale composition.
properties.description: Localized Price or Sale price text exposed as DOM content.

properties.name: compareAtPrice
properties.unsetBehavior: Omit the compare-at element; on-sale is incomplete without it.
properties.description: Complete target-formatted previous price used only with on-sale.

properties.name: compareAtPriceLabel
properties.unsetBehavior: Omit with compare-at content; a rendered compare-at price requires a localized label in usage guidance.
properties.description: Localized Regular price or equivalent text exposed inside the compare-at element.

properties.name: unitPrice
properties.description: Complete target-formatted price and measurement expression.

properties.name: unitPriceLabel
properties.unsetBehavior: Omit with unit-price content; a localized label is recommended whenever unit content renders.
properties.description: Localized Unit price text exposed as DOM content.

properties.name: alternateDigits
properties.description: Enables the active font's ss01 stylistic set; exact glyphs remain font-owned.

properties.name: tabularNumbers
properties.description: Enables stable tabular numeric widths when supported.

properties.name: contextualAlternates
properties.description: Enables contextual alternates when supported by the active font.

properties.name: fractions
properties.description: Enables automatic fractions only for intentionally authored fraction notation.

accessibility: Expose the payable price as visible text and preserve complete target locale and currency formatting.
Use native s plus localized Regular price and Sale price text so compare-at meaning does not depend on line-through or color alone.
Isolate each formatted value bidirectionally without changing the surrounding localized label direction.
Do not give a static Price widget, group, focus, keyboard, or live-region semantics.
Let the owning target region announce dynamic price changes only when its interaction and status policy requires it.

web.notes: Canonical CSS and semantic HTML parts consume complete target-formatted strings without neutral runtime.

shopify.notes: Dedicated Liquid maps product money filters, localized labels, native compare-at semantics, and Shopify's unit-price measurement filter.
